title: Add Piece Path Method in Rust
description: Add a `path` method on PieceStore (semio/rs/src/lib.rs) that returns a Vec<PieceIdDto> representing the path from the fixed piece (root of the parent chain) down to and including the piece itself. It is computed recursively by calling the parent piece's `path` method and appending the current piece's id. If there is no parent_piece, the path is just `[self]`.
